title: Stripo native email creation brief
description: Stripo creation metadata and a native editor model. Drafts are completed, native block types from a reference are preserved, and the result is validated against the downloaded editor schema.

model.description: Native Stripo editor JSON, including metadata.title and metadata.preheader {text, fillSpace} when requested. IDs and default settings may be omitted; native metadata, settings, resources, and block types from a reference are preserved. The downloaded editor schema validates their shape. The builder also limits new or changed metadata text to 500 UTF-16 code units; unchanged longer text requires the acquired rebuild target supplied through --baseline.
